decisions.reason: As a core safety footwear line that gained its own product page by 2024, it fits our main business and appears to have achieved solid market relevance.
The comfort insole supports our footwear system offering and, although only mentioned rather than heavily promoted, it remains a useful complementary product for customer retention and cross-selling.
The supportive insole strengthens our tailored foot-health proposition for workers and specialist retailers, so it is worth retaining as part of the broader fit solution portfolio.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had dedicated visibility in both 2023 and 2024 and aligns closely with our innovation-led strategy in protective footwear.
The firefighter and rescue boots moved from a mention to a dedicated page, indicating growing traction in a specialized professional segment that suits our protective-footwear capabilities.
The moulded insole shows the strongest evidence of market success, with homepage prominence in both years and a specific customer-use result demonstrating demand for individualized insole solutions.
